content.text: Tainted cookie value `bar` from `request.cookies.get` flows directly into an XPath expression string via f-string interpolation, then passed to `lxml.etree.XPath(query)`. No sanitization or escaping is applied before building the query. This is a genuine XPath injection.

input.justification:
The value 'bar' is derived directly from request.cookies.get("BenchmarkTest00018", ...) (user-controlled cookie), decoded via urllib.parse.unquote_plus, and then interpolated unescaped into an XPath query string (query = f'/Employees/Employee[@emplid=\'{bar}\']') which is compiled and executed via lxml.etree.XPath(query). There is no validation, escaping, or parameterization between the tainted source and the XPath sink, so a user can inject XPath syntax (e.g., ' or '1'='1) to alter query semantics - a classic XPath injection.</justification>
